stemMd: One machine beeps every 12 minutes and another every 18 minutes. They beep together at 09:00. When do they next beep together?
explanationMd: The next coincidence occurs after the least common multiple of 12 and 18, which is 36 minutes. Listing their multiples confirms that no earlier positive interval works.

distractorRationale.a: Eighteen is not a multiple of twelve.
distractorRationale.d: Twenty-four is not a multiple of eighteen.
distractorRationale.c: Thirty is a multiple of neither interval.
distractorRationale.b: Sixty is not a multiple of eighteen.
